Land Allocation & Payment Sign-Off

By proceeding with this transaction, you acknowledge and agree to the following binding terms:

Clause 1 — Pre-Checkout Inspection & Satisfaction: Checkout requires prior completion of physical or virtual property inspection. By initiating payment, you confirm you (or your authorized representative) have inspected the land, verified its condition, and logged your status as Satisfied within the platform.

Clause 2 — Title Verification & Allocation Window: Independent survey checks and Land Registry verification (C of O, Gazette, or layout plans) are finalized prior to physical land allocation. Physical allocation is executed upon clean title confirmation and adherence to the agreed payment plan.

Clause 3 — Automated Non-Custodial Split Payments: All payments (outright or installment) are processed instantly via automated payment split logic directly to the designated accounts of the Seller/Developer and MainTown Realty. MainTown Realty operates as a non-custodial facilitator and does not hold or escrow transaction funds.

Clause 4 — Installment Schedule, Grace Period & Default: Installments are due according to the selected schedule. A mandatory 30-day grace period applies to overdue payments. Payments remaining in default beyond 60 days trigger automated contract restructuring or property forfeiture, subject to administrative charges.

Clause 5 — Contract Countersignature & Document Dispatch: Upon checkout, the generated Contract of Sale is routed to the Seller for countersignature under platform response windows. Upon 100% completion of the purchase price and processing fees, the Seller is obligated to issue and upload the Deed of Assignment and primary title instruments, delivered securely to you via the MainTown Realty logistics network.

Step 2 · MainTown Vendor Activation & Land Sales Policy

1. KYC & Identity Verification: You agree to submit valid government identification and bank account details matching your identity prior to listing or receiving funds.

2. Pre-Listing Document Authenticity: You warrant that all uploaded survey plans, Certificates of Occupancy (C of O), or Gazettes are authentic and unencumbered. You consent to automated digital verification via MainTown's AI inspection engine prior to listing approval.

3. 24-Hour Digital Contract Countersignature: Upon a buyer's checkout, you agree to digitally countersign the generated Contract of Sale within 24 hours. Automated platform reminders will trigger every 5 hours until executed.

4. Automated Non-Custodial Split Payouts: You accept that buyer payments (outright or installments) are split automatically at the point of charge and routed directly to your verified payout account, minus platform commissions and legal deed processing fees.

5. Deed Execution & Verified Physical Delivery: Upon 100% completion of buyer payments, you agree to upload the executed Deed of Assignment and surrender original physical title instruments exclusively to the MainTown Realty Logistics Team for secure buyer delivery. Off-platform physical document transfers are strictly prohibited.

6. Pre-Checkout Inspection Access: You agree to facilitate physical or virtual buyer inspections, acknowledging that buyer checkout remains locked until the buyer logs an in-app Satisfied status.
